name: Merge Conflict Kraken
description: Something ancient surfaces in `feature/checkout`. It has many arms and all of them are `<<<<<<< HEAD`.
onCounteredText: You talk through every conflicting line, one by one. The Kraken sinks back into `main`, sated.
onFailText: You resolve it by picking whichever side looks longer. Production disagrees with your choice.

name: Legacy jQuery Reawakens
description: A `$` appears in a file that shouldn't have one. Then another. The console fills with familiar, ancient warnings.
onCounteredText: You wrap it in a namespace and back away slowly. It goes still.
onFailText: It spreads to two more files before you can stop it.

name: 2FA Lockout
description: Your phone is at 2%. The code expires in 30 seconds. It is, of course, the worst possible moment.
onCounteredText: You plug in with seconds to spare and get the code through just in time.
onFailText: You're locked out for the rest of the sprint, refreshing a support ticket queue.

name: The Friday 5PM Deploy Curse
description: Someone deployed on a Friday. At 5:03 PM. On purpose.
onCounteredText: You roll it back before anyone notices. Mostly.
onFailText: You spend the weekend un-breaking production.

name: Off-By-One Error Eats a Day
description: The loop runs one too many times. Or one too few. It has already been six hours.
onCounteredText: You find the exact answer, third reply down, from 2011. It still works.
onFailText: You lose the whole day to it and ship a workaround instead of a fix.

name: Force-Pushed to Main
description: Someone force-pushed to `main`. The last few days of commits are... gone? Maybe? Nobody's sure.
onCounteredText: You had a stash from two days ago. Crisis averted. The team buys you coffee.
onFailText: Three days of history, gone. You start rewriting from memory.

name: Scope Creep Gremlin
description: It started as "just one small tweak." There are now fourteen tweaks. The gremlin is feeding.
onCounteredText: You point to the signed scope in the contract. The gremlin hisses and shrinks back to size.
onFailText: You say yes to "just one more thing" for the fifth time this week.

name: "Just Circling Back on This"
description: A Slack thread from three weeks ago rises from the dead. It has three new participants and no new information.
onCounteredText: You link the README nobody wrote. Technically, this is an answer. The thread goes quiet.
onFailText: You reply "looping in @here" and immediately regret it.

name: Standup That Would Not End
description: It is 47 minutes long. Someone is sharing their screen. Nobody knows why.
onCounteredText: You reignite the tabs-vs-spaces debate. The meeting collapses in on itself and everyone leaves.
onFailText: You get your 90 seconds of update time back. Eventually.

name: The AWS Bill 10x'd Overnight
description: A dashboard nobody checks just turned very, very red. Someone left a loop running. It has been running for nine days.
onCounteredText: The exact fix, third reply down, from 2014. You kill the runaway instance with seconds to spare on the billing cycle.
onFailText: You eat the bill. You will be thinking about this bill for the rest of the month.

name: The Intern Pushed Directly to Main
description: There was no branch. There was no PR. There was, briefly, no CI pipeline either.
onCounteredText: The one working unit test catches it before it ships. Nobody knows why that test still works. You thank it silently.
onFailText: It ships. You spend the afternoon writing a very calm Slack message.

name: Critical CVE Alert
description: A dependency four levels deep in node_modules has a critical vulnerability. It was published nine minutes ago. Security is already asking questions.
onCounteredText: hotfix_FINAL_v2_ACTUALLY_FINAL.sh patches it in prod before the scan re-runs. You will never speak of this again.
onFailText: You open a ticket. The ticket opens a meeting. The meeting opens three more tickets.

name: Cookie Consent Banner Blocks the Demo
description: The banner will not go away. The client can see it. It is, somehow, the only thing anyone comments on.
onCounteredText: You wave the badge, blame the client's ad blocker, and move the demo along.
onFailText: You spend ten minutes of the demo explaining GDPR.
